summary: CreatorOS v4 (Editable Strategy tasks + Pricing tiers with mock Stripe upgrade + Instagram capture in onboarding) — ALL GREEN. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_v4_features.py — (a) GET /api/billing/plans returns 3 tiers (free/pro/studio) each with id/name/price_monthly/features/limits/cta and pro.popular=true; (b) GET /api/billing/plan is 401 without Bearer and returns {tier:'free', name:'Free', features, limits:{chat_daily:10}} for a fresh authed user; (c) POST /api/billing/upgrade {tier:'pro'} returns {ok:true, tier:'pro', mocked:true} AND updates user.tier in Mongo AND follow-up GET /api/billing/plan reflects tier:'pro'. Invalid tier ('enterprise') → 400; (d) PATCH /api/strategy/plans/{id}/task with {phase_index:0,kind:'milestones',task_index:0,checked:true} on a seeded plan (2 milestones + 4 weekly + 2 leading = 8 tasks) returns task_progress={'0.milestones.0':true} and progress_pct=12.5; toggling checked:false removes the key and returns progress_pct=0; GET /plans/{id} confirms persistence; (e) User B toggling User A's plan → 404 (per-user scoping enforced); (f) Invalid kind='junk' → 400; (g) Directly-seeded plan doc includes task_progress:{} field (mirrors what generate would insert per strategy.py line 124); (h) GET /api/integrations/instagram/profile → 503 with detail containing 'Instagram Graph API' and 'Facebook app credentials'; (i) POST /api/onboarding/complete with {youtube_handle:'@mytube', instagram_handle:'@mygram'} strips leading @ → response youtube_handle='mytube', instagram_handle='mygram'; follow-up GET /api/auth/me shows both on user doc + onboarding_complete=true; (j) v3 regression: /dashboard and /portfolio still 401 without Bearer, /, /integrations/stripe/status, /competitors still public. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): (1) /onboarding step 2 now shows BOTH testID='onboarding-yt-input' AND testID='onboarding-ig-input' (with @ prefix + IG-pink logo badge); filling 'freshyt' + 'freshig' and finishing wizard hits /api/onboarding/complete — verified via GET /api/auth/me that youtube_handle='freshyt' and instagram_handle='freshig' saved and onboarding_complete flipped true; Gate then routed the user off /onboarding to /. (2) Profile screen: testID='tier-badge' present with text 'CreatorOS Free · Upgrade' for free-tier user; tapping the badge navigates to /pricing (verified). Also 3 integration rows with correct testIDs — integration-stripe ('Stripe · Not connected · add STRIPE_API_KEY'), integration-youtube ('YouTube @veratube'), integration-instagram ('Instagram @veragram · Graph API coming soon'). (3) /pricing renders hero 'Run your creator business like a $10M SaaS.' + all 3 tier cards (testIDs tier-free / tier-pro / tier-studio); Pro card shows MOST POPULAR badge and gold border; current tier shows CURRENT pill; each has upgrade-{tier} button. Tapping upgrade-pro calls /api/billing/upgrade, refreshes user, CURRENT pill moves from Free to Pro, backend GET /api/billing/plan returns tier:'pro'. (4) /strategy?id=plan-ui-v4-1 renders milestones and weekly_tasks as Pressable checkboxes with testIDs task-milestone-0-{0..1} and task-weekly-0-{0..3}; tapping task-milestone-0-0 then task-weekly-0-0 flips their icons (checkmark-circle green for milestones, filled checkbox green for weekly) AND the plan hero adds a green progress bar showing '22.2% complete' (2/9); backend GET /api/strategy/plans/plan-ui-v4-1 confirms task_progress={'0.milestones.0':true,'0.weekly_tasks.0':true} and progress_pct=22.2 — optimistic UI + backend sync verified. Regression: authed dashboard still renders greeting 'Welcome back, Vera', hero score 87, 4 sub-scores, 2 alerts; 5-tab layout intact; onboarding gate still redirects incomplete users to /onboarding and routes them out on completion. No red-screen errors. Only warning is the pre-existing benign pointerEvents deprecation (carryover from iter_3). No new deprecated Expo packages introduced by v4.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' console warning — non-blocking, not v4-introduced. Reference: (tabs)/*.tsx, onboarding.tsx, pricing.tsx, strategy.tsx Pressables.

critical_code_review_comments: billing.py — TIERS is a plain in-memory dict shared across all users; correct because it's read-only reference data (features/pricing). Free tier metadata is merged into GET /plan via {**info, 'tier': tier_id} spread. Correct.

billing.py:90 — /upgrade uses Pydantic UpgradeRequest with req.tier: str and validates against TIERS dict before writing. No arbitrary field injection into user doc (only tier + tier_updated_at). Safe.
strategy.py:132 — toggle_task correctly enforces user_id in BOTH find_one (line 137) and update_one (line 151), preventing cross-tenant writes even after 404 check.

strategy.py:159 _count_tasks — Correctly walks phases[].milestones + phases[].weekly_tasks and root-level leading_indicators (phase_index=-1). Does NOT count leading_indicators inside phases (matches schema). Divides done/total*100 with zero-guard.

strategy.py:124 — plan insert now includes 'task_progress': {} field before AI JSON spread; since data dict from AI shouldn't include task_progress, the {} is preserved. GOOD, though technically {**data} at line 125 would override task_progress if AI returned that key. Consider `plan = {..., **data, 'task_progress': {}}` to make it defensive. Low risk since STRATEGY_SYSTEM schema doesn't ask AI to output task_progress.
integrations.py:90 — /instagram/profile raises 503 unconditionally with an informative detail. Correct pattern for a deferred integration; matches expected v4 behaviour.
server.py:377 — instagram_handle strip('@') matches youtube_handle handling; both fields optional. Correct.
auth.py:82 — new user document now initializes tier:'free' and instagram_handle:None. Matches v4 User model. Good.
frontend pricing.tsx:20 — Promise.all([billingPlans, billingPlan]) is efficient. Missing dependency array [] on useEffect could be intentional (mount-only); acceptable.

frontend strategy.tsx — task Pressables use optimistic state update then background PATCH; a network failure would silently desync client from server. Consider showing a small toast on error or re-syncing on next mount. Low priority for MVP.
frontend profile.tsx — tier-badge tap → router.push('/pricing') works. Free-tier user sees 'CreatorOS Free · Upgrade' hint; upgraded users would see just the tier name (verified visually).

frontend onboarding.tsx — both handles are passed as trim()||undefined to api.onboardingComplete, so empty strings become undefined and backend correctly no-ops those updates (server.py:375 uses `if payload.youtube_handle` truthy check).

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 v4 tests; plus prior 26 v3 tests still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — onboarding IG capture, profile tier-badge + integrations, /pricing tiers + mock upgrade, /strategy task toggling + progress bar all verified end-to-end with backend sync

seed_data_creation: Backend test fixture (_mk_user) creates ephemeral users user_v4_a_* and user_v4_b_* each with 1-day tokens; cleaned up by fixture teardown (deletes users, sessions, plans, assets, goals, content, recs, chat_messages). For frontend UI tests, two persistent synthetic users were re-seeded in Mongo: (a) user_ui_v4_complete / token 'ui-v4-token-complete' / name 'Vera V4' / onboarding_complete=true / youtube_handle='veratube' / instagram_handle='veragram' / tier='free' (seeded with starter dataset + a hand-crafted strategy plan id 'plan-ui-v4-1' with 2 milestones + 4 weekly + 3 leading indicators); (b) user_ui_v4_onboarding / token 'ui-v4-token-onboarding' / name 'Ozzy Onboard' / onboarding_complete=false (used to test the wizard IG input). Tier and plan progress were reset to defaults between test runs. Cleanup command is in action_items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v4 acceptance criteria fully met. To bypass /login in web UI on next iteration, refresh tokens: python3 -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta; import os; from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env'); db=MongoClient(os.environ['MONGO_URL'])[os.environ['DB_NAME']]; now=datetime.now(timezone.utc); [db.user_sessions.update_one({'session_token':t},{'\$set':{'expires_at':now+timedelta(days=1)}}) for t in ('ui-v4-token-complete','ui-v4-token-onboarding')]". Both tokens have 1-day TTL. Then in Playwright: page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('creatoros_session_token','ui-v4-token-complete')") THEN page.goto(target) — do NOT rely on page.reload() because AuthProvider races with localStorage. Backend intentional non-200s: /api/integrations/stripe/status returns connected:false (sk_test_emergent placeholder); /api/integrations/youtube/channel returns 503 without YOUTUBE_API_KEY; /api/integrations/instagram/profile ALWAYS 503 (by design in v4). /api/billing/upgrade is MOCKED — no real Stripe call. Strategy plan id 'plan-ui-v4-1' is pre-seeded (structure matches AI schema) so tests don't need to hit AI. If you re-run v4 pricing tests, remember to reset user_ui_v4_complete.tier back to 'free' first via: db.users.update_one({'user_id':'user_ui_v4_complete'},{'\$set':{'tier':'free'}}) — otherwise the initial CURRENT pill will already be on Pro. Same for plan-ui-v4-1 task_progress={} reset.

Mock Stripe upgrade behaves correctly and updates Mongo directly, matching v4 spec. Instagram 503 stub returns the expected 'coming soon' payload.
